userStories.title: Add basic error handling and reconnection logic
userStories.description: As a user, I want the editor to automatically reconnect if my connection drops.

Changes sync successfully after reconnection
Error messages displayed for critical failures
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: All acceptance criteria verified via comprehensive automated tests. Enhanced useYjsProvider hook with exponential backoff reconnection (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, max 30s). WebSocket provider configured with maxBackoffTime=30000ms. Error tracking via connection-error event handler. UI displays error banner for critical failures and reconnection info with attempt counter. Document state (Y.Doc, Y.Text) preserved during disconnection - Yjs CRDT queues changes automatically. 11 automated tests covering error display, reconnection tracking, state transitions, and UI reactivity. All 191 frontend tests passing. Typecheck passes. Committed: d7474af.
